body.prompt: Instrumental loop, 70 BPM, 4/4, C-sharp minor, minor key throughout with no major sections. Instrumental only, no vocals with words. Sparse solo piano in C-sharp minor with very long, soft reverb plays a slow, haunting, memorable motif of a few notes that keeps returning, over quiet low chords; a very soft low pulse like a distant drum on every beat; now and then the faint creak of old wooden floorboards; a faint cold wind far away. Lonely, still and uneasy, an empty house at night where something is not quite right. Never horror, no jump scares, no sudden loud hits. Slow, hypnotic and pleasant to hear for an hour, quiet so it sits under people talking. Starts immediately with the full arrangement, no intro, same energy throughout, no build-up, no breakdown, no ending and no fade-out, so it can loop seamlessly.
